newsitem.title: CANADA: St. Lawrence Seaway to raise tolls 2.5 pct Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: St. Lawrence Seaway to raise tolls 2.5 pct Aug 1.

text.p: St. Lawrence Seaway cargo tolls will rise 2.5 percent on August 1, 1997, a joint statement by the Canadian and U.S. agencies responsible for the inland channel said on Wednesday.
The increase will be the first since 1993.

Welland Canal vessel lockage fees will be replaced with an increase in the Welland Canal cargo tolls and vessel charge per gross registered ton (GRT) at the start of the 1998 navigation season, it said.
Seaway tolls are collected by Canada's Seaway Authority for the operation and maintenance of its locks and channels.
The U.S. Seaway Corporation no longer collects tolls and is funded through annual appropriations from the U.S. Harbor Maintenance Trust Fund.
